reason: A browser-side DeepSeek Harness plugin that monitors approval and decision prompts and alerts users with native desktop notifications, sound, and click-to-session navigation.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 出现审批或方案选择请求时，通过桌面系统通知、提示音和点击跳转提醒用户处理。
summaries.en: Alerts users to DeepSeek Harness approval or decision requests with native desktop notifications, a chime, and click-to-session navigation.

capabilities: Observes in-browser session approval and question states
Plays an alert sound using Web Audio
Navigates to the related workspace or session when a notification is clicked
Stores a pending session identifier in localStorage for cross-window navigation
